title: File Explorer
statement:
Build a file/folder tree component with expand/collapse functionality. This challenges tests your understanding of recursive React components, tree data structures, and handling complex nested state.

Your implementation should:
1. Render a hierarchical file/folder structure
2. Support expand/collapse for folders
3. Handle file and folder icons
4. Allow adding/removing items (bonus)
5. Support search/filtering (bonus)
6. Properly manage open/closed state
constraints: Must handle deeply nested structures (5+ levels)
Folder expand/collapse must be O(1) per node
Must not re-render unrelated nodes when state changes
Must display different icons for files vs folders
complexity: Time: O(n) for rendering, O(1) for expand/collapse per node, Space: O(h) where h is tree height
commonMistakes: Creating new functions in render causing all children to re-render
Not memoizing TreeNode component, causing performance issues with large trees
Using array index as key instead of unique IDs
Mutating expanded state directly instead of using immutable updates
Not handling edge cases like empty folders or missing children
Inefficiently checking expansion state for every node
